name: Chicken fajitas (about 30 minutes)
title: Chicken fajitas

steps.text: Slice the chicken into strips. Slice the peppers and onion. Mix chicken with the fajita spice and 1 tbsp oil.
Oven on: 140C fan. Wrap the corn tortillas in foil, ready to warm.
Large pan, high heat, 1 tbsp oil. Chicken in. Cook 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through. Check there is no pink.
Chicken onto a plate. Same pan: peppers and onion in for 6 to 8 minutes until soft and a bit charred.
Chicken back in the pan. Squeeze over half the lime. Stir 1 minute.
Tortillas into the oven in their foil.
Put salsa in a bowl. Soured cream and grated cheese in bowls for the others.
Everything to the table. Build your own fajitas.

prep: Chicken breast out of the fridge
Peppers and onion ready to slice
shopping: 1 pack fajita seasoning (check it is gluten-free)
soured cream and 100 g cheddar for the others only (one person avoids dairy)
